change.summary: EU Member States must transpose the Directive into national law by 19 December 2025 and apply it from 19 June 2026. The Directive amends rules for distance-selling financial services contracts.

obligations.text: Adopt and publish national laws transposing the Directive.
obligations.quote: Member States shall adopt and publish by 19 December 2025 at the latest, the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with this Directive.
They shall apply those measures from 19 June 2026.

obligations.text: Communicate transposed measures to the Commission.
obligations.quote: They shall immediately communicate the text of those measures to the Commission.

reasons: The directive covers distance-selling of financial services contracts, but you sell furniture and leather goods, not financial services.
All three obligations are addressed to EU Member States to transpose and publish national laws, not to individual shops or traders.
